story: Ben wanted to read a storybook inside, but the door was locked. The key was missing. Mum said, “I can help you.” Ben said, “I lost the key.” Mum gave Ben a spare key. Ben unlocked the door with the spare key, and he stepped inside the cottage. Ben returned the spare key to Mum. Ben said, “I promise to look for the key tomorrow.” Ben wrote a note, and he hung the note on the hook. The key was missing, but Ben opened the storybook beside Mum.
